name: Tesseract🌟
description:
While drawn, the bow pulls items to you and small entities into its [effect:tesseract][dark-gray]tesseract[/dark-gray][/effect]. Mobs fired from the tesseract deal their attack damage as bonus damage. You can fire without any ammo available, releasing a 3❤️ base damage energy shot.

Mythical enchantment discovered on the Relic: [gradient:purple:green]I.R.I.D.E.S.C.E.N.T.[/gradient]

effects.explanation: An 18-slot item inventory which can hold projectiles or absorbed mobs, who become spawn eggs. Their spawn eggs cannot be removed from the Tesseract except by being fired.
